case: SDK 1.13 single-lot cn-standard notice (DEU, negotiated-with-call procedure) from a university: managed security services and the build-out of a Security Operations Centre, CPV 72514100 (facilities management involving computer operation) with 72800000 and 72220000 additional, NUTS DE600, EUR 5,500,000, no submission deadline published. A security procurement whose MAIN CPV is an operations code rather than a security one — the case that shows why the additional-code list has to be scored and not ignored, and a restricted-access procedure type on a lot a supplier would otherwise want.
